藏品名称_EN: foreign envoy from an imperial tomb
描述_EN: when the figures arrived at the v&a they were described as korean, since korean noblemen wore similar wide-brimmed horsehair hats. however, the combination of korean headwear with chinese robes is not known elsewhere, so instead the official probably represents a generic foreign envoy and is shown presenting a casket that might be a container for a gift or document. his robes are carefully carved to represent cloud-patterned silk and the square badge of rank on his back bears a scaly dragon. like the sculpture to the left, this imposing figure once formed part of a spirit way leading to a tomb of a prince or another member of the imperial clan.
描述_ZN: 当这些人物到达V&A时，他们被描述为韩国人，因为韩国的贵族都戴着类似的宽边马鬃帽。 然而，韩国人的头饰和中国人的长袍的组合在其他地方并不出名，所以这个官员可能代表了一个普通的外国使节，并展示了一个可能是礼物或文件容器的匣子。 他的长袍是精心雕刻的，代表了云纹丝绸，他背上的方形等级徽章上有一条鳞片状的龙。 与左边的雕塑一样，这个雄伟的人物曾经是通往王子或其他皇室成员坟墓的灵路的一部分。
